rules.description: Ferieloven: 2.08 paid holiday days per month of employment = 25 days per full year

versions.notes: borger.dk: "Du optjener 2,08 feriedage pr. måned … 25 feriedage, hvis du er ansat et helt år"; holiday taken 1 September – 31 December of the following year (ferieperioden). Holiday pay (12.5%) and the 5 extra "feriefridage" by agreement not modelled. Verified as the law in force on the verification date; historical effective date not researched, so effectiveFrom is set to 2026-01-01 (earlier dates resolve to the parent/none).

rules.description: National transposition status of the EU Pay Transparency Directive (EU) 2023/970

source.title: EUR-Lex: national transposition measures communicated for Directive (EU) 2023/970

versions.notes: EUR-Lex lists no notified Danish measures (checked 2026-10-18). Industry reports (Dansk Erhverv, 8 Oct 2026) say the government tabled the bill amending ligelønsloven with proposed entry into force 1 March 2027 — not verified on ft.dk/retsinformation.dk.
